consent.bakebot: Order updates come from BakeBot, KD Pops' automated assistant. Kaydee reads and confirms every order herself.
consent.popia: To process your order we keep your name, cell number and language. Only Kaydee and her helper can see them. They are stored securely by Supabase in the EU, never used for marketing, and deleted 90 days after your last order.
consent.agree: I agree to KD Pops using my details for my order
consent.guardian: My parent or guardian says it's OK for me to order
consent.declined: No problem. Nothing has been saved. You can still order by sending Kaydee a WhatsApp.
consent.guardianNeeded: Please ask a parent or guardian first. Nothing has been saved. You can also order through Kaydee on WhatsApp.

templates.acknowledgement: Order {order_number} received – Kaydee will confirm after school.
templates.waitlisted: Order {order_number} is on the waitlist because this week is full. Kaydee will let you know if a spot opens.
templates.quote_pending: Order {order_number} received. It's a big one, so Kaydee will send you a quote after school.
templates.confirmation_cash: Order {order_number} is confirmed! Collect it on {date}, {slot}, at {place}. Please bring {amount} in cash.
templates.confirmation_eft: Order {order_number} is confirmed! Collect it on {date}, {slot}, at {place}. Please pay {amount} by EFT using reference {reference}. Send your proof of payment to {email} with {reference} as the subject, or upload it on your order page.
templates.declined: Sorry, KD Pops can't take order {order_number} this time. Nothing is owed. Thank you for understanding.
templates.payment_received: Payment for order {order_number} received. Thank you!
templates.ready: Order {order_number} is ready! Collect it on {date}, {slot}, at {place}.
templates.delayed: Sorry, order {order_number} is delayed. Your new collection day is {date}.
templates.proof_received: We received your proof of payment for order {order_number}. Kaydee will check it soon.
templates.proof_rejected: We couldn't match the proof of payment for order {order_number}. Please check the amount and reference, then send it again.
templates.payment_reminder: Friendly reminder from BakeBot: order {order_number} is not paid yet. Please pay {amount} by EFT using reference {reference} before {date}. Already paid? Email your proof to {email} with {reference} as the subject.
templates.released: Order {order_number} was not paid in time, so the pops have been released for sale. If this is a mistake, please talk to Kaydee.
templates.collect_reminder: Your paid order {order_number} is still waiting for you. Please talk to Kaydee to arrange collection.
templates.feedback_request: Thank you for collecting order {order_number}! How were your pops? Leave quick feedback below.

chat.title: BakeBot
chat.disclosure: Hi! I'm BakeBot, KD Pops' automated assistant (not a person). I answer questions about the menu, prices, ordering and collection using answers Kaydee has approved. For anything else, tap "Talk to Kaydee".
chat.checkWithKaydee: I'm not sure about that one, so I'll check with Kaydee.
chat.handover: I've passed your question to Kaydee. She's in class during the day and usually replies after school (from about 15:00).
chat.contactPrompt: Leave your name and cell number so Kaydee can reply on WhatsApp:
chat.contactThanks: Thank you! Kaydee will reply on WhatsApp after school.
chat.fallback: BakeBot can't answer right now, so here's the order form. You can also WhatsApp Kaydee.
chat.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
chat.limit: This chat is getting long. Please talk to Kaydee or use the order form.
